claims.text: The CoVoST dataset was created from 11 languages into English, featuring over 11,000 speakers and more than 60 accents, ensuring a diverse representation of speech.
Raw MP3 audio files were converted into mono-channel waveforms, downsampled to 16,000 Hz, and transcripts were normalized and tokenized for consistency.
Quality checks were performed on translations, including manual inspections and similarity score calculations to ensure high-quality data.
The dataset includes a rich diversity of accents, with over 1,000 speakers contributing to the transcripts, enhancing the model's training and evaluation.
